name: Edgar Gipeldi
source:
The King's counselor.
The former king Heintz's nephew, and the protagonist's older cousin.
When [url=/c54024]Cain[/url] was 'convalescing from his accident' Edgar and his father [url=/c54033]Austin[/url] were taking over the governance of the country.
The type who's always overflowing with confidence and thinking he's the best.
He's always sweet towards his younger sister [url=/c54032]Cossette[/url].
